tool.name: ParaFEM Post-Processor
tool.description: Package ParaFEM solver output into EnSight Gold format for ParaView
tool.command:
mkdir -p output && cp '$d_file' output/job.d &&
#if str($bnd_file) != "None" cp '$bnd_file' output/job.bnd && #end if
#if str($fix_file) != "None" cp '$fix_file' output/job.fix && #end if
cd output && pf2ensi job 2>&1 && cd .. &&
tar xzf '$ensi_tarball' -C output/ 2>/dev/null;
if ls output/job.ensi.NDPTL-* 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'scalar per node:		Potential	job.ensi.NDPTL-******
' >> output/job.ensi.case; fi;
if ls output/job.ensi.NDTTR-* 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then NSTEPS=\$(ls output/job.ensi.NDTTR-* | wc -l); printf 'scalar per node:	1	Temperature	job.ensi.NDTTR-******
' >> output/job.ensi.case; printf 'TIME
time set:	1
number of steps:	%s
filename start number:	0
filename increment:	1
time values:
' "\${NSTEPS}" >> output/job.ensi.case; seq 0 \$(( NSTEPS - 1 )) | xargs printf '%10E ' >> output/job.ensi.case; fi;
if ls output/job.ensi.DISPL-* 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'vector per node:		Displacement	job.ensi.DISPL-******
' >> output/job.ensi.case; fi;
cd output && tar czf ../ensi_package.tar.gz job.ensi.* && cd .. && mv ensi_package.tar.gz '$output_ensi' && cp output/job.ensi.case '$output_case'

param.name: ensi_tarball
param.label: Solver EnSight output (.tar.gz)
param.help: Tarball of .ensi.NDPTL-* or .ensi.NDTTR-* files from solver

data.name: output_ensi
data.label: EnSight Gold package (.tar.gz)
data.help: Complete EnSight Gold case for ParaView

tool.help:
Assembles ParaFEM solver output into a complete EnSight Gold case for ParaView.
Uses pf2ensi to generate the geometry (.ensi.geo) and case (.ensi.case) files from the mesh .d file, then adds the solver's scalar field output (NDPTL for steady-state potential, NDTTR for transient temperature).
Output is a tarball containing all .ensi.* files. Open the .ensi.case file in ParaView to visualize the results.
For steady-state (p123): scalar potential field For transient (p124): temperature field with time steps
